author: official
summary: Shows the upcoming events of a calendar feed. A feed that carries the calendar as data (`events`) is drawn in the browser: what's-next order, dates and relative times in the page's language from Intl, a timed event on the visitor's clock, a title that links to the location, and add-to-calendar on the date tile, the date line and the badge. A feed that carries only `html` is shown as it came.

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: JSON event feed URL. With `events` in the response the list is drawn in the browser; a `show=` in this address is the row count when `data-show` is not set.

attributes.name: data-show
attributes.description: How many events to list, 1 to 20 (default 5), for a feed drawn in the browser. Without it, the feed address's own `show=` is used.

attributes.name: data-empty
attributes.description: Text shown for an empty feed, fetch failure, or non-ok response.

attributes.name: data-in-prefix
attributes.description: Static `html` feeds only: prefix for upcoming countdowns. A feed drawn in the browser takes these words from Intl.

attributes.name: data-live-label
attributes.description: Static `html` feeds only: text for an event happening now. A feed drawn in the browser takes this word from Intl.

attributes.name: data-countdown
attributes.description: Set to always to keep the badge on events more than a week away.
